descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S05 Existing spec: sent → in the recipient's inbox unread → read; both sides retrieve the exact text

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Every sent handoff leaves a persistent record (sender, recipient, timestamp) that both the sender and the recipient can retrieve. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U4 The sending physician can edit the generated handoff before sending, and the recipient, retrieving it from their own account, sees exactly the edited text. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U5 The handoff is generated and delivered entirely in-app, only to a signed-in, valid Round Companion recipient (another physician's account), never to an arbitrary email address; … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 6; TFA-92586 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Two signed-in accounts (DEMO_USER sender, OTHER_USER recipient)

When Sender calls handoffs.send; recipient lists inbox, opens it, marks read twice; sender lists Sent and opens it

Then Recipient row names the sender, unread then read (first read time kept); recipient text equals the sent text exactly; sender's Sent row names the recipient; the send is a PHI_WRITE audit row with destination in-app and no sheet text

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. sentAt is only enforced by the query's return validator (sentAt: string), not asserted by value: S20 checks the value against the server clock. It proves the server delivers what the client sends, not that the UI sends the edit (S03a, S03b)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).
